name: Burn-ey Sanders
alt: A soot-smudged Bernie Sanders lectures a glaring sun while his microphone melts.
blurb: The sun asked him to yield. He demanded a recorded vote.
facts: Vermont first elected Sanders to the U.S. Senate in 2006.
He served as mayor of Burlington before going to Congress.

name: V.D. Jance
alt: A startled JD Vance tries to plug a briefcase that is spraying green slime.
blurb: The briefcase came with a lock, two keys, and a full gallon of ooze.
facts: Vance became the 50th U.S. vice president in 2025.
He previously served in the U.S. Marine Corps.

name: Howard Nutlick
alt: A grinning Howard Lutnick taste-tests the green kernel of a head-sized pistachio.
blurb: Some people crack a pistachio to see what’s inside. Howard goes straight to the taste test.
facts: Lutnick was sworn in as U.S. secretary of commerce on February 21, 2025.
credit: Nickname inspired by Tim Miller of The Bulwark

name: Marco Rubble-O
alt: Marco Rubio emerges from a crumbled lectern and manages to hold a glass of water upright.
blurb: The lectern gave way halfway through his remarks. The water stayed in the glass.
facts: Rubio represented Florida in the U.S. Senate from 2011 to 2025.
He served as speaker of the Florida House from 2006 to 2008.

name: Chuck Chummer
alt: Chuck Schumer ladles pink chum from a skiff as a shark fin approaches a floating gavel.
blurb: He dropped his gavel overboard. Something in the pool voted aye.
facts: New York first elected Schumer to the U.S. Senate in 1998.
In 2021 he became the first New Yorker to serve as Senate majority leader.

name: Ted Cruise
alt: Ted Cruz argues with a seagull from an inflatable boat stranded in a snowdrift.
blurb: The brochure promised a heated pool. The pool would like to see that in writing.
facts: Cruz was sworn into the U.S. Senate in 2013.
As Texas solicitor general, he argued eight cases before the U.S. Supreme Court.
